Davidson 25th Annual Diversified Industrials & Services ConferenceHUNTSVILLE, Ala., Sept. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Lakeland Industries…

children: Management to Host One-on-One Institutional Investor Meetings at the Lake Street Capital Markets 10th Annual Best Ideas Growth (BIG10) Conference and the D.A. Davidson 25th Annual Diversified Industrials & Services Conference

, a leading global manufacturer of protective clothing and apparel for industry, healthcare and first responders, today announced that management will attend the Lake Street Capital Markets 10th Annual Best Ideas Growth (BIG10) Conference and the D.A. Davidson 25th Annual Diversified Industrials & Services Conference in September 2026.

Lakeland Chief Revenue Officer Barry Phillips and Chief Commercial Officer, Global Industrials, Cameron Stokes will attend the Lake Street Capital Markets 10th Annual Best Ideas Growth (BIG10) Conference on September 10, and President, Chief Executive Officer and Executive Chairman Jim Jenkins and Chief Financial Officer Calven Swinea will attend the D.A. Davidson 25th Annual Diversified Industrials & Services Conference September 23-25, where they are scheduled to host one-on-one meetings with institutional investors at each event.
Lake Street Capital Markets 10th Annual Best Ideas Growth (BIG10) Conference
Location: The Metropolitan Club, New York, NY
Attendees: Chief Revenue Officer Barry Phillips, Chief Commercial Officer, Global Industrials, Cameron Stokes
D.A. Davidson 25th Annual Diversified Industrials & Services Conference
Attendees: President, Chief Executive Officer and Executive Chairman Jim Jenkins, Chief Financial Officer Calven Swinea

For more information on the Lake Street Capital Markets 10th Annual Best Ideas Growth (BIG10) Conference, the D.A. Davidson 25th Annual Diversified Industrials & Services Conference, or to schedule a one-on-one meeting with Lakeland management, please contact your conference representative or you may also email your request to LAKE@mzgroup.us or call Chris Tyson at (949) 491-8235.

Lakeland Fire + Safety manufactures and sells a comprehensive line of fire services and industrial protective clothing and accessories for the industrial and first responder markets. In addition, we provide decontamination, repair and rental services that complement our fire services portfolio. Our products are sold globally by our in-house sales teams, our customer service group, and authorized independent sales representatives to a strategic global network of selective fire and industrial distributors and wholesale partners. Our authorized distributors supply end users across various industries, including integrated oil, chemical/petrochemical, automobile, transportation, steel, glass, construction, smelting, cleanroom, janitorial, pharmaceutical, and high-tech electronics manufacturers, as well as scientific, medical laboratories, and the utilities industry. In addition, we supply federal, state and local governmental agencies and departments, including fire and law enforcement, airport crash rescue units, the Department of Defense, the Department of Homeland Security and the Centers for Disease Control. Internationally, we sell to a mix of end-users directly and to industrial distributors, depending on the particular country and market. In addition to the United States, sales are made into more than 50 foreign countries, the majority of which were into China, the European Economic Community ("EEC"), Canada, Chile, Argentina, Commonwealth of Independent States (“CIS”) Region, Colombia, Mexico, Ecuador, India, Uruguay, Middle East, Southeast Asia, Australia, Hong Kong and New Zealand.
For more information about Lakeland, please visit the Company's website at www.lakeland.com.

title: Lakeland Fire + Safety to Attend Upcoming Investor Conferences in September
